Madhya Pradesh to Launch 350 New Government Buses on September 25

Madhya Pradesh will launch the 'Mukhyamantri Sugam Parivahan Seva' (Chief Minister's Accessible Transport Service) on September 25, with 350 new government buses set to operate across the state. A state-level event will be held in Bhopal, where Chief Minister Mohan Yadav will flag off the buses destined for various cities. Union Minister Nitin Gadkari is also expected to be present at the Bhopal event to give the green signal.
